title: GTA 6 Only Lets You Carry 4 Guns (The Rest Go in Your Trunk) 🔫 #Shorts
description:
In GTA 6 you can carry only two handguns and two long guns at once. Everything else stays in the trunk of a car you own, and ammo, body armor and explosives bought at Ammu-Nation are sent straight to that trunk. Guns you buy have a light blue icon and are yours; enemy guns are white and temporary. Busted or wasted? Your owned guns can be recovered from your trunk or an Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Jason and Lucia share owned guns, but modifications are per character.

Sources: GTABase (GTA 6 weapons list; GTA 6 wanted level & police system guide, updated Nov 21, 2026) and Insider Gaming (GTA 6 full weapons guide, Nov 18, 2026).
Images: Rockstar Games (An Extended Look, Trailer 2, official screenshot).
